Round-3 review of WP-SCP-022 v0.3.

You reviewed v0.1 in R1 (CHANGES_REQUESTED) and v0.2 in R2 (CHANGES_REQUESTED with 2 MAJ + 1 MIN + 1 nit new findings on top of the v0.1 closures).

v0.3 was authored by Opus orchestrator as the R2 fix-round, claiming to close every CRIT and unmitigated MAJ raised in either prior round.

Apply the CORRECTNESS lens fresh against v0.3. You have not seen the fix-round narrative — only the resulting plan, helper scripts, and decision/backlog updates.

Verify each R2 correctness finding is closed in v0.3:
- R2-C-MAJ-01 (gate_check.sh hash-chain documented but not implemented): inspect scripts/wp_scp_022_gate_check.sh — is there a check_hash_chain function with --check-hash-chain mode? Does it actually verify a sha256 chain over reviewer-result JSONs?
- R2-C-MAJ-02 (D-027 in DECISIONS.md preserved v0.1 sequence): inspect docs/DECISIONS.md D-027 row — does it now reflect the corrected Track 1 sequence?
- R2-C-MIN-01 (USER-GATE-A0 helper validates only signer line): does the helper now check timestamp + canary-run-id?
- R2-C-nit-01 ('four' vs five blob SHAs): are §6 + §9 internally consistent?

Apply the lens fresh:
- Are the new gate-helper exit codes (0/1/2/3/4/5/6/10) consistent across §4.7 plan text and the script's usage block? Are all six error categories actually triggered somewhere in the script?
- Is the new R-022-13 (020J partial-apply rollback) coherent? Does it specify what Codex must do to detect partial apply, and does the dispatch-package contract for 020J include the verify_commands needed to enforce it?
- Does the v0.3 plan correctly note all helper-script exit codes are reachable test cases? (i.e., is exit 5 'hash-chain mismatch' actually reachable from the implementation, or is it dead code?)
- Plan version is now 0.3 — is the version-bump consistent across the document header?
- DECISIONS.md / BACKLOG.md / plan body — any new internal-reference inconsistencies?

Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. Verdict APPROVED if all R2 findings closed AND no new MAJ findings; APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS if MIN/nit residuals only; CHANGES_REQUESTED if any unmitigated MAJ remains.
